title: Google's New AI Feels Like the Future
description:
Google just introduced Dreambeans, an experimental AI app that creates personalized daily stories based on your interests, activities, and connected Google apps.

Instead of endless scrolling, Dreambeans uses AI to surface ideas, recommendations, and insights that actually matter to you.

This could be one of Google's most personal AI experiences yet.
